schema: private typed-constructor literal recipe201-v1; not a current Project wire format or executable parser
independent_oracle_basis: All graph bodies, clone bodies, ID maps, wire tables, edit literals, expected scalars/errors and histories were authored before any duplication implementation. Public default constructors are explicit complete typed recipes pinned by SOURCE_CONTEXT_AND_CURRENT_FEATURE_VS_MAIN_AUTHORITY_PINS.json. No implementation result is an oracle.

recipe_rules.values: exact ir::Value tag; Float must use binary64 bits; nonfinite layout value uses binary32 bits
recipe_rules.schemas: Execute only the named current public constructor and explicit override map; no other fields/default guesses
recipe_rules.format_options: current pinned mapping::FormatOptions::default with no overrides
recipe_rules.layout_fingerprint: Exact existing unchanged public checksum of the entire independently literal Project; not omitted/normalized. Its hexadecimal result is prospective until root materialization, not an invented current wire golden.
recipe_rules.open_states: Complete native Snarl open_by_stable_node_identity; no new serialized CanvasLayout fields. All true controls use the existing restore default.
recipe_rules.snapshot_references: Every history/save-reload state name resolves to the complete snapshot within that same case
recipe_rules.wire_order: Complete semantic edge table sorted by stable node identity/pin; all edge endpoints and counts must match. Whole native Snarl originals are retained separately. Snarl allocation IDs/hash iteration order are not wire-format policy.
recipe_rules.input: exact empty Group with Unknown origin; no runtime defaults/source loading
recipe_rules.history: All existing complete Project/layout values are compared; labels/lengths/undo-redo restored complete snapshots use the existing SnapshotHistory APIs. The private recipe is not the private history struct's serialization.
recipe_rules.named_layouts: The explicit named fixture carries complete primary + Target(0) positions and native canvas states. Both already materialized mapping canvases receive new frames. No target or scope is cloned.
recipe_rules.nonfinite_refusal_equality: For complete snapshots containing a nonfinite f32 layout literal, exact equality compares that field by its declared binary32 bits, not NaN numeric PartialEq; no field is dropped or normalized.
